dialogue: [color=#cd2d06]Violets's Tips #1:[/color] The basics of slide boosting!
I break slide boosting down into [color=#f8c868]3 steps[/color].
First [color=#f8c868]hold the direction[/color] you want to go, then, hold {Down}, and press {Jump}
That's only like 3 things total! It might be a lil tough but I bet you can get the rhythm down!
And lil secret: You can even slide boost on flat ground!
The only requirement, is that your moving fast enough to be sliding.
It just happens hills help you move that fast.
Slide boosting on flat ground can help you find silly shortcuts.
So I highly endorse mastering the flat ground slide boost.
And one last thing. You can't slide boost if you're going uphill.
